title: Bianchi-Type Black Holes in Higher-Dimensional $R^2$ Gravity
summary: In this study, we investigate higher-dimensional static and stationary Bianchi-type solutions in an $R^2$ gravity theory using the formalism of exterior differential forms. We construct a broad class of exact higher-dimensional Bianchi-type solutions in an $R^{2}$-corrected gravity theory. It is shown that the theory admits hyperscaling violating black hole solutions associated with homogeneous but anisotropic horizon geometries, encompassing both static and stationary configurations.
